invariants.rationale: The method is called with a list to be parallelized, which cannot be null for meaningful execution.
Parallelism should be a positive integer to make sense for parallelization.
The method always returns a non-null HoodieData instance.
HoodieListData.eager(data) preserves data order and content, so the resulting HoodieData when collected equals the input list.
The implementation specifically returns an eagerly evaluated HoodieListData.
